application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
decision_conditions: The proposed work is to be carried out to British Standard 3998 (2010) Tree Work Recommendations, by a reputable tree surgeon to the satisfaction of the Tree Preservation Officer who should be informed of the date of commencement of work.
description:
T1 Cedar Large, prominent tree in rear garden. 
Last pruned (thinned and reduced) in 2021. 

Thin crown / branch ends by 20-25% to create an even density of crown throughout. Reduce crown all round by 2-2.5m and balance. Prune to suitable points of regrowth. Remove deadwood, stubs and crossing branches.

Thin crown / branch ends by 20-25% to create an even density of crown throughout. Reduce crown laterally all round by 2-2.5m and balance. Prune to suitable points of regrowth. Remove deadwood, stubs and crossing branches.

Current crown height - approx. 20m
Proposed crown height following pruning - approx. 20m

Current crown width - approx.18m
Proposed crown width following pruning - approx.16m

The reason for the proposed works is to maintain the tree in a safe condition and to reduce the chances of lateral limb failure which is very common in the species. Similar works were carried out in 2021.
